stepBody: Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' ').##figure7.gif##

figureAlts.figure7.gif: Finish the following code to help Tiffany simulate 100 rounds of the game and assign the variable win_proportion to the proportion of rounds she wins. The code begins with count set to 0. There are four blanks to fill in: Blank 1 is part of a for loop, Blank 2 is part of an if statement, Blank 3 is an indented line under the if statement, and Blank 4 is part of the assignment to win_proportion.
